DX11 ordinary profile verified 2026-09-30: selectors12D..146 outside mode5 use alpha property slot+08 and shader property slot+18. Alpha-test enabled iff alpha flags200 and (shader flags800 clear or shader opacity+20<1). Blend enabled iff alpha flags1 and (opacity<1 or shader flags100 set). If neither enabled (including null alpha), write RS15=0 then27=0 only. Otherwise write RS27, optional19/20 from manager+20 selector table, RS15, optional25 from manager+4C and RS24 reference byte alpha+1A. Then ALWAYS stencil/cull property via manager+20 from propertyState+1C, then wire property via manager+24 from propertyState+28. No Z-buffer/shade/material property dispatch here. Special selector/mode5 branches require separate recipes.
